title: Path from component representative
statement: Let $q$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $G$ be a finite unique game with a nonempty finite set of variables and a nonempty finite set of constraint occurrences. Each constraint joins two distinct variables and carries a permutation of the $q$ labels, and every variable occurs in a constraint. For each variable, the component representative is joined to it by a walk, with each constraint traversable in either direction.
hypotheses_covered: The variable set is finite and nonempty
The constraint-occurrence set is finite and nonempty
Each constraint carries a permutation of the $q$ labels
Every variable occurs in a constraint
